notes.title: Quality Update
notes.content:
Update Info
1.Add Item Quality And Refine Mode
2.All Content Related To Quality And Refine Adjust
The Following Content Changed:
Price, Translate, Image, Build, Use, Quest, Backpack, Item Drop, Skill, Sort, Strength, Unit, Bullet, Produce, Toast
3.Fix Show Stand Problem Of Direct Give Treasure Box
4.Display Show Stand Apply Quality Medal

Item Quality and Refining Info
1. After the quality reaches a certain level, the quality medal will be automatically obtained
2. Quality effects or prices are only related to medal
3. Any items obtained with medal cannot be combined
4. Any item can be generalized into a non-medal item through the refining furnace
5. Generalization keeps the number of items constant
6. The same item with different or the same quality can be refined into other quality items
7. The number of items after refining is half of the original
8. The quality after refining is related to skills, refining furnace medal, and the quality of refining items
9. The refined quality ranges from the lowest item quality +1 to the highest item quality +1
10. The quality items purchased in the store are the lowest quality items that meet the standard
11. Time-limited quests accept items of any quality

notes.title: Quality Update In Progress
notes.content:
In the quality update, the following functions are expected to appear
1. All items will add quality levels, and items of different quality levels will not stack
2. The default quality level is 0
3. The same items of different quality levels are refined into items of other quality levels according to certain rules
4. Items of different quality levels can be purchased in the shop, and the default is the minimum quality level that meets the standard
5. The higher the quality level of the item, the higher the value
6. Combine quality level changes according to certain rules
7. New quality skill, production, drops, etc. are related to this upgrade
8. The number of dropped items has been reduced, which is converted into dropped items of the corresponding quality level
9. The quality level will be displayed in the shop, backpack. You can set whether to display it in the settings menu
10. Added an independent sorting, sorting by quality level

No enemy, still have enemy base

Items and experience cannot be obtained by defeating enemies

notes.title: Now Released
notes.content:
Please Have Fun

FAQ

Q: Is the game a full version?
A: Yes, the game is a full version, and adding DLC is not considered. The content will continue to be updated in the future.

Q: Does the game need to be connected to the Internet?
A: The game can run normally without being connected to the Internet. All game-related data is stored locally, and the game does not collect any user information.

Q: What will be updated in the future?
A: There are two main directions for game updates. One is to improve and enrich the diversity of existing game, and the other is to add something special. The main game will not change much.

Q: What should I do if I find something wrong?
A: It is recommended to send it to the community for discussion, or provide a screenshot of the bug or a more specific text description, and send the final saved file data to the customer service mailbox as an email attachment, and we will deal with it as soon as possible.
